thread:
maya: Heads up — seeing a sawtooth pattern of 502s on the guest API /v1/generate during large-batch embeddings. Spike every ~40–60s, lasts ~15–25s. Sample trace id: trc_9f7a. Customer can repro with multi-embed payloads.
sam: Can you paste a failing request + response? Any common headers or tenant tags?
maya: Reproducer (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer GUEST_***' -H 'X-Tenant: guest-xyz' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small","inputs":["p1","p2",...,"p20"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Payload is ~20 prompts in one batch. Works then 502s for a short window.
alex: Do we have Envoy/edge logs for those windows? Look for upstream 502 vs 504 and `rst_stream` from upstreams.
maya: Pasted a snippet from edge logs around the spike:
```
[edge] 2026-03-15T09:12:34Z conn=1234 route=/v1/generate tenant=guest-xyz upstream=auth-proxy status=502 reason="upstream reset: rst_stream" trace=trc_9f7a
```
opsbot: PagerDuty alert INC2345 created: "Edge gateway 502 spike - guest embeddings" — https://pd.internal/INC2345
luke: I can see midproxy metrics showing h2.session_streams_active peaked and keepalive pool exhaustion. h2.streams_active ~1024, keepalive_conn_count dropped during windows -> connection churn + auth proxy rotate could be triggering upstream closes.
sam: Repro tip for SRE: run the curl in a tight loop (~1s interval) with the 20-item batch until you hit 502s. Compare single-item batches vs large batches. Also try varying `Connection: keep-alive`/`close`.
maya: Immediate mitigation: throttled guest batch-size to 4 and bumped route timeout to 90s. Frequency of spikes dropped. Also temporarily disabled batch fanout for guest tier.
alex: Short-term rollback: paused auth key rotation for guest tier (rolled back PR #4321). Long-term actions: tune h2 windowing, add per-tenant concurrency cap at edge, and add per-route backpressure to avoid midproxy pool drain.
maya: Notified customer about mitigation and they confirmed reduced errors. Opening support ticket SUP-983 for tracking follow-up and customer comms.
luke: I'll collect pcap + Envoy configs + heap profiles from affected hosts during the next spike. Assigning oncall to investigate correlation with auth rotations. Ping @luke if you see another spike. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks — leaving monitoring on. We'll sync for postmortem once we have pcap and full traces.
